value.rationale: The 2026 source formulates fixed-pattern occurrence probability in 2-binomial fibers as a research problem with approximation algorithms. The result supplies exact, all-parameter conditional probabilities for the complete natural smallest balanced length-four pattern family. Its nontrivial counts separate multiplicative divisor behavior from additive interval-count behavior, sharpening a probability-estimation problem to formulas, while explicitly crediting prior unit normal forms and the Gaussian denominator.
